verdict.rationale: The franchise-tax/annual-report page states the operating window up front: "This application is available daily between 8:00 am and 11:45 pm Eastern Time." The entry page also mentions a 15-digit saved session ID, which implies sessions, but no timeout duration is disclosed and no per-day limits are published. Missing for 10: published session-timeout duration, any statement on per-day limits, and operating-hours disclosure for the Document Filing Service used for formation.
